protocol.scope: Same3 old FFHQ images x4tasks x sigma.05/.10. Same learnedA71 nine-unroll prefix. One fixed intervention in last unroll; native continuation afterwards. Not a new online algorithm or independent30-call reconstruction.
protocol.reference: Negative gradient wrt next noisy state of .5||y-H(clamp(raw denoiser mean_s))||^2, at uncorrected DDPM next state. Real next-network inputVJP; original network weights never updated. Not unconditional score, next-time numerical step control, JAPS proximal target, or SURE.
protocol.directions: NATIVE q; DIAG_ALIGN projection of physical gradient onto cone{P_b q} of original db4/level3 ten orthogonal components, then normalize whole vector; PHYS_DIRECT unrestricted physical gradient normalized. Reference/projection depend only on y/state, never GT.
protocol.lengths: Each direction independently tested at .5/1/1.5 times original native q norm. Fixed paired diagnostic ladder, NOT selected by GT/loss, no new scalar policy, no global shrink norm anchor inside a proposed online method. No upper2 gamma rule.
protocol.cone: Coefficients max(0,<P_b q,g>/||P_b q||^2). This maximizes whole-vector cosine in the feasible cone; all directions matched in length before comparisons. Zero cone/reference marked unresolved, no fallback/substitution.
protocol.noise: GT read only after each pre-specified continuation for offline exact identity: physical loss gain = clean-measurement gain + <actual measurement noise, response>. Noise remains unknown to controller. No noise-separation/SURE or unbiased full-image risk claim.
protocol.pairing: BASE_NATIVE100 replay must match original BASE paired tensor relativeL2<=1e-6. Same given y/mask/init/current DDPM innovation; future CPU/CUDA RNG equal across arms. Exactly14 native continuation forwards. GT only final/next-clean/region metrics.
protocol.timing: Shared16F prefix plus1F/1VJP reference are separate. Arm clock includes its14 native continuation calls andCPU sync; offline H/metrics/image writes separately. Not complete300 walltime or production timing; model load/warmup separate.
protocol.decision: Primary orientation test DIAG_ALIGN100 vsNATIVE100 at equal lengths: per task/noise meanPSNR>=+.1dB,>=2/3 wins,SSIM nondecrease,LPIPS nonincrease. DIRECT100 diagnoses cone restriction. Length ladder descriptive only; no per-case best arm/GT selector. Mixed/negative retained.
protocol.resources: AllocatedGPU>=6GiB before load; real checkpoint VJP peak+1GiB checked after warmup and before unstarted work. No precision/resolution change, process termination or automatic failed-attempt retry.
protocol.limits: One fixed intervention, one seed and reused panel. Local physical descent need not imply final quality; local full/observed/missing GT errors are diagnostic only. Not matrix novelty, universal improvement, noise-unbiased estimate or inference speedup.
